source: Owner 2026-11-22: web strategy specs (RS breakout, ORB 30m, 52-week high, NR7, VWAP reclaim, volume dry-up pullback, gap-and-go). Same ideas as the GeminiNeon bundle but with the spec's volume confirmation, time windows, trend filters and exit conditions. Liquidity floor on every entry (owner: Rs 15 Cr median turnover, close >= 50, both from yesterday).
exit_note: Owner rule 2026-11-20 kept: stop 0.2% beyond the last swing, target 2x risk (tuning sweeps rr), intraday square-off 15:15 / no entry after 14:45. The spec's ATR stops/targets are not used; its trend exits are kept as exit conditions ('when'). Opening-range / first-bar lows as stops are not supported by the engine.

strategies.name: Web-RS Breakout
strategies.description: Relative strength: Nifty 50 flat/down over 5 days while the stock is up, close above the 20-day high on 1.5x volume. Exit also when close < EMA 20.
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (bench(close / close[5] - 1) <= 0 and close / close[5] - 1 > 0 and close > highest(high, 20)[1] and volume >= 1.5 * sma(volume, 20))
assumptions: Official Nifty 50 history from 2024-01-01 only (NSE MCP); earlier years produce no signals.

strategies.name: Web-Opening Range Breakout 30m
strategies.description: First 15m close above the 09:15-09:45 range high between 09:45 and 14:15, volume 1.5x the same time slot's usual volume.
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (minute_of_session >= 45 and minute_of_session <= 300 and cross_above(close, or_high(30)) and slot_rvol(20) >= 1.5)

strategies.name: Web-52 Week High Breakout
strategies.description: Close above the highest close of the last 250 sessions on 1.5x volume while above EMA 50. Exit also when close < EMA 50.
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (close > highest(close, 250)[1] and volume >= 1.5 * sma(volume, 20) and close > ema(close, 50))

strategies.name: Web-NR7 Breakout
strategies.description: Yesterday was the narrowest range of 7 days above EMA 50; today closes above yesterday's high (engine enters next open - the spec's intraday stop-entry is approximated). 5-bar time stop.
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and ((high[1] - low[1]) <= lowest(high - low, 7)[1] and close[1] > ema(close, 50)[1] and close > high[1])

strategies.name: Web-VWAP Reclaim
strategies.description: Stock above yesterday's close; previous bar at or below VWAP, this bar closes back above VWAP as a green bar on 1.2x slot volume, before 14:30.
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (close > prev_day_close() and (low[1] <= vwap[1] or close[1] < vwap[1]) and close > vwap and close > open and slot_rvol(20) >= 1.2 and minute_of_session <= 315)

strategies.name: Web-Volume Dry-Up Pullback
strategies.description: Uptrend (close > EMA 20 > EMA 50, +10% in 20 days) followed by 2-4 down days on volume below half the 20-day average, then a green bar closing above the previous high on average volume.
strategies.entry: median(volume * close, 20)[1] >= 150000000 and close[1] >= 50 and (any_of(close > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 50) and close / close[20] - 1 >= 0.10, 6)[2] and count(close < close[1] and volume < 0.5 * sma(volume, 20), 4)[1] >= 2 and close[1] < close[2] and volume[1] < 0.5 * sma(volume, 20)[1] and close > open and close > high[1] and volume >= sma(volume, 20))

strategies.name: Web-Gap and Go
strategies.description: Open 2% above yesterday's high but at most 8% above yesterday's close; after 09:30 and before 13:00 the first close above the first 15m bar's high while the day never broke that bar's low, on 1.5x slot volume.
strategies.entry: avg_day_volume(20) * prev_day_close() >= 150000000 and prev_day_close() >= 50 and (session_open >= 1.02 * prev_day_high() and session_open <= 1.08 * prev_day_close() and minute_of_session > 15 and minute_of_session <= 225 and cross_above(close, or_high(15)) and session_low >= or_low(15) and slot_rvol(20) >= 1.5)
